text:
Hi there, and thank you for contacting Leafy! I'm sorry your package seems to be stuck. I know it's worrying when there's a plant on the way, so let's get this sorted.

Since your tracking hasn't moved in 4 or more business days, you're right on time to ask us for help. Here's what happens next:

- **Contact support** with your order number, either here in chat (8am-8pm Mon-Sat, your local time) or by email at help@leafy.example (answered within 1 business day).
- **We open a courier investigation**, which can take up to **5 business days**.
- **If the package is found to be lost**, you can choose either a **free replacement** or a **full refund**.

A couple of helpful notes:

- Tracking can take up to 24 hours to update, but since yours has been still for 5 business days, it's well past that.
- If you choose a refund, it goes back to your original payment method. Cards take **5-10 business days** once issued, and digital wallets take **3-5 business days**. Store credit is instant if you'd prefer that.

If you share your order number here, I can get things moving for you. Please don't send a full card number or any passwords.

We'll do our best to get your plant to you safely. Please reach out anytime if you have more questions!
